T: Wax on. Wax off. Eat up.
D: A new kid in town learns karate from an apartment handyman to stand up to bullies.
P: Serve the mains when Mr Miyagi catches the fly with chopsticks.
S: Edamame steamed 4 minutes and tossed with flaky salt and sesame oil, plus cucumber batons quick-pickled for 20 minutes in rice vinegar, sugar and sesame. Chopsticks only.
Mr Miyagi grew up in Okinawa
Purple sweet potato sliced paper thin on a mandoline, soaked 20 minutes, dried, fried at 170C until crisp, salted, with a wasabi mayo for dipping.
Broccolini blanched 1 minute, charred in a smoking pan with garlic, tossed in oyster sauce and sesame oil, stood up in a little dish like a row of trees.
M: the plate of spaghetti Daniel ends up wearing
Big plate of spaghetti in a rich tomato and beef sauce with parmesan. Best eaten, not worn.
a bowl from Miyagi's home island
Pork belly simmered in soy, mirin, sugar and ginger for 2 hours until soft, served on thick wheat noodles in a broth of chicken stock and bonito, pickled ginger on top.
W: Glutinous rice flour, sugar and water stirred into a dough, steamed 20 minutes, kneaded smooth, wrapped around balls of red bean paste and dusted with cornflour.
K: Sencha steeped in water just off the boil (about 80C) for 1 minute, poured into small cups.

s.how: Steam 400g edamame for 4 minutes and toss with flaky salt and sesame oil. Cut a cucumber into batons and pickle for 20 minutes in 3 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tsp sugar and sesame seeds. Serve both with chopsticks only.
Blanch 2 bunches broccolini for 1 minute and drain. Char in a smoking pan with 2 sliced garlic cloves. Toss with 2 tbsp oyster sauce and a splash of sesame oil. Stand them up in a dish like trees.

m.note: the plate of spaghetti Daniel ends up wearing
m.how: Brown 500g beef mince with 1 onion and 2 garlic cloves, add 700g passata and 1 tsp oregano and simmer 30 minutes. Cook 400g spaghetti, toss with the sauce and serve with 50g grated parmesan and basil.

w.how: Stir 200g glutinous rice flour, 60g sugar and 220ml water into a dough. Steam for 20 minutes, then knead smooth on a cornflour-dusted bench. Divide into 8, wrap each around a ball of red bean paste and dust with cornflour.

d.how: Heat 1L water to about 80C, just off the boil and cooled a little. Steep 4 tsp sencha for 1 minute only, then pour into small cups. Refill the pot for a second round.
